title: Streaming lifecycle: client cancel, disconnect/resume, server timeouts, and OpenAI-compat improvements
author: Avery Park
description: Motivation: production streaming endpoints were brittle on client disconnects and did not provide a reliable resume or safe-cancel story for tool/function calling and structured output. This PR implements streaming lifecycle controls: (1) explicit client cancel semantics that let the server differentiate user-initiated cancel vs network disconnect; (2) short-term reconnect/resume support using resumable stream tokens and idempotency markers; (3) server-side idle and request timeouts with configurable policies and graceful flushing of function-calling state; (4) consistent OpenAI-compat streaming chunks and markers so existing clients see minimal behavior changes. Changes are backward-compatible by default and gated behind a runtime feature flag. Summary of changes: see commits and files_changed. Testing: added unit tests for lifecycle FSM, integration tests simulating disconnect/resume, and e2e tests exercising long-running tool calls across reconnects. Rollout: feature flag off by default for hosted; Enabled in Dedicated internal canaries for 48h, then staged to hosted. Backwards compatibility: existing non-resumable streams behave exactly as before; resumable behavior appears when client supplies "resume_token" header or when server emits a "resume_token" in the initial chunk. Migration notes: SDKs will be updated to expose resume helpers; OpenAI-compat wrappers will continue to emit canonical data events and special control events ("__resumable__","__cancel_ack__") documented in release notes.

review_conversation: Maya Chen (reviewer): Can you clarify how we garbage collect stale resume tokens? We should ensure tokens expire server-side after a short TTL.
Avery Park (author): Good catch — added token TTL and server GC job; default 5 minutes. Configurable via feature flag config in streaming_resumable.yaml.
Luca Romano (reviewer): The FSM looks good but please add more assertions around KV cache invalidation when a resumed request uses different model variant.
Avery Park (author): Added model-variant check and explicit cache reset path; documented invariant in protocol.md.
Priya Nair (approver): Verified integration test runs and load test on dedicated canary. Approving with request to monitor 95p latency after rollout.
CI Bot: All checks passed (unit, integration, linters). Flaky e2e rerun fixed transient network issue.
Release Manager (comment): Feature flag gated. Schedule rollout window 2026-03-05 00:00 UTC for hosted gradual enablement after verification.
release_notes: Streaming lifecycle: Add resumable streaming (resume_token), explicit client cancel semantics, and server-side idle timeouts. Backwards compatible by default. SDKs will receive helpers for resume/cancel. See docs/release_notes/2026-03-streaming-lifecycle.md for details.
